messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: METRICS_ALERT: metering.token-count-drift detected in prod-eu1. +11% token delta vs baseline over last 30m. Some customers receiving overage flags. Ops runbook: https://internal.redwood/in/incident-runbooks/metering
jamie: acked. I'm on call. tagging @billing_lead and @maria for triage. any immediate customer-impact list? :eyes:
maria: looking. quick check shows consumer-lag on metering-collector-kafka  -> 1200 msgs behind. running query for per-customer deltas now.
mike: seeing repeated 500s from proxy-emitter earlier at 03:12-03:19 UTC, might explain dropped events and subsequent reconciliation gap. logs: `emitter/err: write timeout`
maria: query result (top 3 deltas): AcmeCorp +42k tokens (spike), beta-saas +8k, devops-tooling +6k. baseline for AcmeCorp ~320k/day, so temporary +13% which triggered overage flag.
jamie: ok plan: 1) mute external overage emails 2) create live customer notification only for impacted top-5 3) run immediate consumer reprocess/backfill for 03:00-03:30 window 4) escalate to billing team for temporary credit if needed. @billing_lead you good?
billing_lead: on it. muting notification emails now. /ops mute alert metering.overage.email --scope=prod-eu1 --duration=2h
oncall-ops: confirmed email mute applied. customers will still see portal flags unless we pause flags at enforcement layer.
mike: starting reprocess job for the lagged partition (job id run-2026-03-21-01). expect ~20-30m for initial catch-up, will post progress.
maria: quick sanity check SQL I'm running for reconciliation:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_delta) AS window_tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-21T03:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-21T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY window_tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
will share CSV when done.
jamie: tagging product & support: we should prepare a short note for AcmeCorp if their dashboard shows overage. @mike priority = ensure we don't double-count when backfill finishes. add idempotency guard.
billing_lead: agree on pause-for-flags for top impacted customers. I'll open a billing action: "temporary flag pause + manual review" for AcmeCorp and add 24h credit hold if delta > 10%.
mike: reprocess job started. initial tail catch-up speed ~2k msgs/sec. ETA 18m to clear 1200 messages (est). updating every 5m.
maria: CSV posted: https://internal.redwood/recon/4376543210/recon.csv — AcmeCorp row includes metadata showing emitter errors at 03:14.
jamie: thanks. quick safety: enable fallback routing to dedicated-metering for 10% of traffic to reduce pressure on collector while we stabilize. @oncall-ops can you apply?
oncall-ops: applied routing rule: mirror 10% -> dedicated-metering-pool. will hold for 30m then reevaluate.
mike: reprocess at 03:30 status: 60% done, no duplicate tokens emitted (idempotency check passing).
billing_lead: paused enforcement flags for AcmeCorp and beta-saas. sending manual hold messages to billing queue. will prepare credit estimate after recon completes.
maria: reconciliation complete. post-backfill delta now within +/-1% vs baseline for top accounts. attaching final counts.
jamie: confirmed reduction in overage flags. unmute external emails in 30m after we confirm no flapping. also creating follow-up action: postmortem + timeline + fix to emitter retry logic and consumer partitions.
billing_lead: filing customer comms draft for AcmeCorp and beta-saas, will route for approval.
mike: reprocess finished at 03:48. consumer lag cleared. logs saved to s3://redwood-ops/reprocess/4376543210.log
jamie: great work. closing live-handoff in 45m. action items: (1) engineer to harden emitter retry + backoff (2) add alert for kafka-consumer-lag > 500 for 10m (3) runbook update to include temporary flag pause procedure. assigning to @maria, @mike, @billing_lead respectively.
maria: taking runbook update.
mike: will file emitter PR.
billing_lead: will follow up on credits + customer emails.
incident-bot: Incident 4376543210 -> RESOLVED (mitigations applied, backfill successful). Postmortem link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/4376543210 — please add notes. :white_check_mark:
